summary: Proofs are mathematically well-structured and the PVAggregation/PiecewiseC1On generic-induction refactors are a real improvement, but the same derivWithin-endpoint-congruence argument is written out four times instead of being a lemma, and the main assembly is a 195-line proof with two independently factorable blocks.
